newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share index rises on fresh buying.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share index rises on fresh buying.

text.p: The Jakarta composite index rose 1.08 percent to 630.55 points on fresh buying in several blue-chips and secondaries before slipping back in mid-afternoon trading on Wednesday, brokers said.
The index eased back to 629.58 points on profit-taking by 0845 GMT, they said.
"Overall market sentiment is quite firm with further rises in Telkom helping push up the index," a broker with a London-based securities house said.
Brokers said targets for both local and overseas buyers included Telkom, Indosat, Citra Marga and cigarette firms Gudang Garam and Sampoerna.
Telkom rose 100 rupiah to 4,050 rupiah before easing back to 4,025 rupiah on a volume of 2.4 million shares.
Toll road operator Citra Marga was up 25 rupiah to 1,925 rupiah after touching 1,975.
An analysts' meeting called by the company boosted morning sentiment, but operators later took their profit, brokers said.
The company projected net profit of 145 billion rupiah for 1997, compared with an expected profit of 123 billion this year. Analaysts said the figures were within their expectations.
